svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources, optional (stop); Structure architect (agent); Outline approval (stop) | paper: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, written in config.md (question); Literature strategist, unless you give your own sources (agent, only when needed); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: review.md and refs.bib (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Structure architect (agent); Outline approval (stop); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
